t: This is Atkinsons Building, on the corner of Old Bond Street and Burlington Gardens, which includes numbers 2 and 4 Burlington Gardens. It was built in 1926 in the Gothic Revival style, with Arts and Crafts detailing, and it is Grade II listed. The architect was E. Vincent Harris, who designed several important public buildings in traditional styles. So you are looking at a traditional design from the 1920s on a busy corner of Mayfair.
